theory: Qualify steepness comparisons: they require the same axis scales and units, and greater steepness means greater magnitude of rate, not necessarily a greater signed gradient. State that a horizontal line has zero rate, exclude vertical lines from the quantity-over-time rule, and distinguish negative gradient from the positive magnitude requested by 'rate of decrease'.
